name: io.github.Servosity/threecx-mcp
title: 3CX MCP
description: 3CX for MSPs: trunk, licence, version and backup health across every client phone system.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Set the THREECX_CLIENT_ID credential for the 3CX MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the THREECX_CLIENT_SECRET credential for the 3CX MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_FQDN
environmentVariables.description: Host name of the 3CX phone system (for example pbx.example.com), the {fqdn} in https://{fqdn}/xapi/v1.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Full XAPI base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds https://<THREECX_FQDN>/xapi/v1. Set it only to point at a different host or port.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_TOKEN_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave blank: the CLI uses the phone system's own /connect/token. It must be on the same host as the API.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_OAUTH_SCOPE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Scope sent with the client-credentials exchange. Leave blank to send none.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_FLEET_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Absolute path of the directory holding the registry of client phone systems used by the fleet commands. Leave blank to use the CLI's config directory.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_PBX
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Name of one phone system registered with fleet add; the server then uses that PBX's host, client ID and secret variable (the same as --pbx). Leave blank to use THREECX_FQDN and the credentials above.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

environmentVariables.name: THREECX_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on 3CX requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
